policy: Routes identify frontend views and are not invented URLs. Adapt presentation to the question; preserve actual block scopes and current tool contracts.

views.label: Visão gerencial
limitations: Volume independent of period; field work company-wide; sectors ignore period.
Old /dashboard/gerencial and /dashboard-gestao routes redirect to home.

views.label: Visão operacional
limitations: Current stock differs from period flows.
Fields absent from MCP cannot be recreated from screenshots or inferred.

views.label: Desempenho da frota
limitations: query_data(logger_performance) filters AND; legacy list may differ.

views.label: Diagnóstico individual do logger
limitations: Keep units returned by tool, including battery and acoustic quantities.
Images up to 1024px, series may be truncated.

views.label: Vazamentos e reparos
limitations: Current status is not historical backlog.
Monthly CSV selection is specific and not equivalent to all repairs in month.

views.label: Investigação de campo
limitations: No sector FK; do not infer membership by proximity.
No dedicated complete track-history tool; audios may have metadata only.

views.label: Localização sugerida e recorrência
limitations: No complete point cloud: include_points forced false.
Cluster ID is transient; no network/boundary reconstruction.

views.label: Utilização de pontos para faturamento
limitations: Not monetary billing or Accounts subscription.
Current device link does not reconstruct historical point continuity.

views.label: Identidade e estrutura organizacional
limitations: Accounts grants/subscriptions/UUID joins not exposed by current MCP.
Only product projections and public fields can be queried.
